Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Fabricația de mase plastice și Fabricația de ambalaje și recipiente
What You Will Enjoy Doing
 The Service Desk Agent is responsible for providing first-level support to users, ensuring efficient and reliable operation of the service desk. This role involves handling service requests and incidents, delivering excellent customer service, and maintaining communication with users.
Managing service requests and incidents via the ticketing system, telephone, or MS Teams.
Supporting clients remotely through telephone, email, and remote desktop.
Providing 1st level support: Identifying, qualifying, prioritizing, and resolving tickets.
Escalating or dispatching tickets that cannot be resolved to the 2nd level support groups.
Maintaining an up-to-date knowledge base by documenting all issue resolutions and creating IT training documents.
Monitoring the health status of systems and alerting the service owners depending on the criticality.
 What makes you great
Communication Skills: Good communication skills, both oral and written (English, nice to have: German).
Listening Skills: Effective listening skills.
Attitude: Positive "can-do" attitude.
Customer Orientation: Customer-oriented approach.
Technical Education: Entry-level technical education, such as a diploma or associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
ITSM Knowledge: Basic theoretical and practical ITSM knowledge, familiar with the ITIL Framework.
 What you can expect working with us
 Join an international work environment within a 100% family-owned company. 
 Enjoy a secure future with us – as a manufacturing company, we are globally on a growth path. 
 Benefit from personalized training and ongoing professional support to ensure your development and success. 
 Take advantage of the possibility of home office. 
 Enjoy various benefits, including discounts for gym/sport subscriptions, meal tickets, medical subscriptions, bonus for Christmas & Easter holidays, vouchers for minor children on different occasions (e.g. 1st of June), bonus for women on 8th of March, and dedicated programs for employees (e.g. ALPLA Family Day).
